elevenlabsPrompt:
[exasperated] Mac app frozen with that spinning wheel and nothing works?

[confident] Here's the fix. Force quit it from the keyboard.

[friendly] Press Command, Option, Escape. Select the stuck app. Click Force Quit.

[delighted] The frozen app closes, everything else keeps running.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
